title: The workflow roles and personas
situation: The operator, 2026-10-15, confirmed after two read-backs: the workflow becomes intent-based delegation instead of a prescribed procedure. The assayer is replaced by the reviewer, and cuts no longer record holders.
decision: Generic roles: lead (owns a story's realization), builder (one task, one pull request), reviewer (reviews one pull request it did not write; never builds or repairs it), and the specialists called in for a story's risk: illustrator (examples cold from concepts only) and check-writer (checks binding examples, seen failing before the build). Reviewers, the illustrator and the check-writer run on another model family than the builders where one is available. Personas over the architect, each named for its expertise: kino (film production), nico (the corpus's concept space and the cold-decode oracle), mav (any software repository). Cratylus's own contexts are held by the architect.
